summary: PR 679 fixes the two prior-review parser counterexamples, but the exact candidate still misclassifies YAML AMDGPU metadata values as instructions in real final ISA and implements only the ISA-analysis portion of the original six-part request.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the recorded base raises ModuleNotFoundError because the final-ISA analyzer does not exist.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-41249d1a0709/venv/bin/python (multiline-comment and same-line-label assertions on parent candidate 716219a9b7bd7b2b9632123f95433a0745e3045a)
tests.what_was_measured: Independently reproduced the prior review: block-comment contents produced false MFMA/store counts and entry: s_nop 0 was omitted.
All 5 candidate regression tests passed, including multiline block comments and same-line labels.
Adjacent multiline comments and multiple labels, commented metadata, hexadecimal resource values, and representative instruction-family counts passed.
31 tests passed and 2 environment-dependent tests skipped; analyzer and existing compiler option/codegen compatibility were exercised.
Two tests passed on gfx950: optimized GPU reduction agreed with the portable GPU reference and final-ISA generation/shape assertions passed.
Adversarial real-output failure: reported 35 instructions rather than 28 by counting seven YAML metadata values as opcodes.

gpu_execution_evidence: One available gfx950 device; two independent extension tests passed, including a portable numerical reference. Raw output is in reports/j-41249d1a0709/raw/gpu.log.
remaining_counterexamples: Real LLVM AMDGPU final assembly contains a YAML block between .amdgpu_metadata and .end_amdgpu_metadata. Scalar values such as global_buffer, by_value, kernel_0, kernel_0.kd, and false are accepted as opcodes, inflating the retained gfx950 sample from 28 to 35 instructions.
Physical VGPR/SGPR pinning or named register-region reservation remains unimplemented.
Exact hand-scheduled region preservation and MFMA co-execute-window assertions remain unimplemented.
The requested first-class AMD instruction helpers remain unimplemented.
The requested exact low-level buffer load/store API remains unimplemented.
The requested compiler-option sweep example remains unimplemented.
remaining_limitations: The candidate is a partial ISA-analysis feature and does not fully resolve the original issue.
Static counts do not establish cycle timing, dependency correctness, occupancy, performance parity, scheduling preservation, or physical register placement.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only Python, tests, documentation, and reports; native source is unchanged.
Only gfx950 hardware was available; other CDNA and RDNA architectures were not tested.
Direct upstream issue API access was blocked by the ROCm organization's token-lifetime policy; the supplied snapshot and accessible mirror/repository evidence were used.
